summary_of_work: Read THREAT_MODEL.md, AUDIT.md (components, rules), the campaign context, the manual's machine_config chapter (processor/uarch/hash_tree config, memory ranges, cmio, dtb) and HTIF/CLINT/PLIC/PMA sections.

Code read: machine::machine/init_processor/validate_processor_shadow/init_pmas_contents/init_hot_tlb_contents/init_console, write_reg (raw shadow writes), machine_address_ranges (push_back/check/flash/nvram/cmio/virtio, prepare_ar_backing_store*), address_range constructor checks, hash_tree::check_address_ranges/create_nodes (rounded-length alignment and overlap), interpret()/interpret_loop entry checks, get_pending_irq_mask/get_highest_priority_irq_num/assert_no_brk (asserts compiled into the uarch), riscv-warl.hpp and DEFINE_SA_WARL_READ in i-state-access.hpp, shadow_tlb_verify_slot and its native (init_hot_tlb_slot, mark_write_tlb_dirty_page) and uarch-bridge (do_verify_cold_tlb_slot, do_read_pma, mock ranges) users, find_pma, read_ram_uint64, machine::read_word/write_word, send_cmio_response, uarch_reset_state and their regenerated Solidity (readIflagsY, isYieldedManualWith), HTIF/CLINT/PLIC devices, rtc tick logic, collect_mcycle_root_hashes, collect_mcycle_bundle, collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes preconditions, interpret_with_console and machine_console::putchars, page_hash_tree_cache borrow logic, dtb_init size guards.

Experiments (scratch dir RGCONFIG/): (1) rx and tx buffers backed by the same shared file: refused at creation (exclusive flock on shared backing files), so range aliasing through backing files is not an accepted configuration. (2) Configs with mie=mip set to unimplemented interrupt bits (0, 2, 12, 13, 16) vs implemented bits: native run and run_uarch agree (no interrupt for unimplemented bits, identical root hashes, uarch halts normally); explained by WARL legalization on every read in i_state_access, so the uarch assert in get_highest_priority_irq_num is unreachable from configs. (3) Non-power-of-two RAM (1 MiB + 4 KiB) and flash drives (12 KiB at 0x100000000, 12 KiB at 0x00FFFFFFFFFF0000): 171 proofs of every page/word/node of the padded regions at heights 5..21 fold to the root, get_node_hash equals target_hash, word leaves equal keccak of read_memory. (4) Store/load (clear_hash_tree) round trips of read-only flash, read-only NVRAM, shared flash, created flash, length-from-file flash, 8 flash + 8 NVRAM: same root hash, log_step_uarch works after load.
not_covered: No EVM (Solidity step) run on configs with flash drives at high addresses or non-power-of-two ranges; only the C++ paths were exercised. Reasoned only: the Solidity verifier works on 64-bit addresses and 56-bit-capped ranges never reach the last 32-byte leaf (R1-R10-2).

No long differential native-vs-uarch run of a guest that exercises flash/NVRAM/PMA-table/DTB execution/CLINT msip+mtimecmp/PLIC claim with config-set girqpend/girqsrvd under an unusual layout; consistency was argued from shared device and interpreter code plus WARL-on-read.

Processor backing images (processor.backing_store.data_filename) carrying a crafted shadow TLB, revert root hash or non-WARL register patterns were only reasoned about (native init_hot_tlb_slot and uarch verify_cold_tlb_slot both use shadow_tlb_verify_slot against identical PMA data; out-of-range pma_index maps to an empty sentinel in both); not run.

iprv = 2 (reserved) and other non-WARL registers with spec-illegal values (pc odd, misa bits, mstatus UXL/SXL) were not run; they are not values the spec allows, so outside the R4 configuration clause.

Supplying stale backing_store.dht_filename/dpt_filename or hash_tree.sht/phtc files in a creation config (documented reuse of cached tree data; O1 territory, already noted by R3-VARCACHE) was not re-tested.

Flash/NVRAM placement rules versus the manual (below RAM, 2 MiB alignment, 64 TiB cap) are pending as R3-VARSPEC-5 and were not re-examined; noted only that machine_address_ranges::check rejects a range ending exactly at 2^56 (end > AR_ADDRESSABLE_MASK), a harmless false rejection.
JSON-RPC create path (JSON number conversion of config fields) and the cartesi-machine CLI config builders were not examined.
sha256 configurations (no referee verifier supports them; collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes/log_step_uarch refuse them by design) were not pursued.
Runtime options (concurrency, console destinations and buffer sizes, no_reserve) were only read for transition effects; no thread-count differential run.

PRT player, bridge and Dave behavior on templates with unusual but legal configs (e.g. template mcycle near 2^64, iflags.H and iflags.Y both set with an accepted tohost, flash drives present) were not run.
